kinds.name: StarPass
kinds.note: A multi-use pass for Middle Passage valid for one year after first use.

kinds.name: Pension x2
kinds.note: Each doubling is of the original: the first x2 doubles the Pension, the second triples it.

kinds.name: Retirement x2
kinds.note: Each doubling is of the original Retirement Pay.

kinds.name: Wafer Jack
kinds.note: A cyber implant allowing use of skill or personality wafers.

kinds.name: Forbidden Knowledge
kinds.note: Uncouth in polite society; the skill is rolled on chart M1's 1D table.

kinds.name: Knighthood
kinds.note: Raises any value of Soc to B; a character already Soc 11+ receives Soc +1 instead. In the Spacer, Soldier and Marine careers it is available to Officers only: a non-officer receives Soc +1 (even if it advances Soc to 11 or beyond).

kinds.name: Directorship
kinds.note: An appointment to the Board of Directors of a large corporation.

kinds.name: Proxy
kinds.note: A delegation of power to vote in the Moot.

kinds.name: Life Insurance
kinds.note: Archives a personality scan and DNA sample at muster out; on notice of death it enables a Clone and implantation of the archived personality. Unless updated, the clone reverts to the memories and skills recorded at muster out. It may also be purchased: MCr1 to start a policy, Cr100,000 to update.

kinds.name: TAS Fellowship
kinds.note: A temporary membership in the Travellers' Aid Society: one week of accommodations and one High Passage per month, accumulating if not taken. The grant expires four years after award, and accumulated benefits expire with it.

kinds.name: TAS Life Membership
kinds.note: One week of free accommodations and one free High Passage per month, for life. It can be purchased for MCr1 and cannot generally be sold.

kinds.name: Ship Shares
kinds.note: A fractional ownership; chart S (p. 90) prices ships in shares.

kinds.name: Land Grant
kinds.note: A token annual profit: Cr10,000 per Trade Classification, or Cr5,000 on a world with none.

kinds.name: Fame
kinds.note: Chart M1 lists Fame among the Automatics rather than in either Benefits column, but four career tables award it as a benefit cell — chart 02 and chart 03 at Fame +1, chart 05 and chart 09 at Fame +2 (interpretation I-72).

entitlements.name: Functionary's Pension
entitlements.note: Replaces a Citizen's Pension, if any (p. 69).
